theorems.name: Submission.submanifold_divergence_identity_compact
theorems.statement: ((∀ (n N : ℕ) (r : ℕ∞) (M : Set (Rn N)) (V : Set (Rn n)) (W : Set (Rn N)) (ψ : Rn n → Rn N), 1 ≤ r → Chapter02.IsSimonLocalRepresentation r M V W ψ → ∀ x ∈ V, tangentSpace M (ψ x) = LinearMap.range (fderiv ℝ ψ x).toLinearMap) ∧ ∀ (n N : ℕ) (r : ℕ∞) (M : Set (Rn N)), Chapter02.IsSimonSubmanifold (E := Rn n) r M → MeasurableSet M ∧ ContinuousOn (tangentProjection M) M) → ∀ (n N : ℕ) (M S : Set (Rn N)) (Y : Rn N → Rn N), Chapter02.IsSimonSubmanifold (E := Rn n) 2 M → ContDiff ℝ 1 Y → IsClosed S → (∀ x ∉ S, Y x = 0) → IsCompact (M ∩ S) → IntegrableOn (tangentialDivergence M Y) M μHE[n] ∧ IntegrableOn (fun y ↦ inner ℝ (Y y) (meanCurvature M y)) M μHE[n] ∧ ∫ y in M, tangentialDivergence M Y y ∂μHE[n] = -∫ y in M, inner ℝ (Y y) (meanCurvature M y) ∂μHE[n]
